title: Can the authentic Journal text produce one justified instruction?
why: This separates a usable metapuzzle from patterns we can notice after knowing the answers.
known: The earlier answer initials and letter counts can be reproduced; a decoder has not been established.
answer_needed: A fixed rule supported by the clue or formatting, applied consistently to the original text.
how: Compare the existing Journal captures and source text. Record exactly which characters and layout the rule uses.
would_change: A unique result strengthens the Journal interpretation (I008/I013 and T003). A rule needing arbitrary choices does not.

title: What exactly happened in the reported music attempts?
why: A note sequence with no outcome cannot settle whether playing music matters.
known: E005 leaves its setup and outcome incomplete. The November 12–13 reports add tuning-fork and active-event procedures, but still lack isolated Journal results.
answer_needed: The player’s actual sequence, instrument, event state, active riddle and before/after Journal result.
how: Follow the linked original post and any existing recording or follow-up. Keep unstated details unknown.
would_change: A documented procedure narrows T004/T006; it does not automatically test every event-ending variation.

title: Has anyone recorded the Better Together ending itself?
why: Playing during the active event and assembling after it ends are different procedures.
known: The ending message describes surviving spirit. AR-07 reports no R6 advance after five region representatives returned to the lake. It does not establish a lasting effect or document staying together through the ending.
answer_needed: A continuous record of a group already at the lake through the ending, with a Journal check on both sides of the transition.
how: Look for an existing complete record. Compare staying in place with the reported regrouping, and separate music or item drops from the event transition.
would_change: A timed advance would select an action to reproduce. No change would cover only the recorded group/location setup.

title: Which old tests actually performed the assembly action?
why: A finished-item drop and a native filling or conversion interaction are not the same test.
known: Chum filling and Shaggy acquisition in the lake are already reported. Physical fossil patterns are also recorded.
answer_needed: For a specific candidate: action, ingredients, active stage and explicit Journal result.
how: Compare E006, E011–E013 and their source posts before describing an action as untested.
would_change: A matching documented failure lowers that procedure’s priority. A missing record alone does not make it new.

title: What source would identify the surviving thing?
why: The spirit and instrument readings still lack a source selecting a real completion action.
known: There are relevant stories and ordinary quest dialogue, but no demonstrated Hunt-specific link.
answer_needed: A particular line, interaction or observation connecting the body, its loss and a collectible or reconstructable remainder.
how: Check original dialogue and game text against the complete chain. A matching word by itself is not enough.
would_change: A direct link can select a mechanic to investigate; without it, these readings stay on the watchlist or parked.

title: What was the actual Journal result after the despawn procedure?
why: The procedure gets cited in absence theories, but it has no explicit result in the preserved report.
known: Arbor described waiting for the Callings and Feather to despawn before further offerings.
answer_needed: An existing follow-up identifying the active riddle, remaining objects, next offering and Journal outcome.
how: Check the original thread and any already available follow-up. Do not turn silence into a negative result.
would_change: An explicit outcome narrows that sequence. It still would not identify what R6 asks us to assemble.

title: Which tooltip colors were available before a solve?
why: A usable clue must be available when the player is meant to recognize it.
known: The R1 recording distinguishes the Chestplate before completion and the highlighted solved Journal. It is not a stock-client comparison. The November 24 video claim remains unverified.
answer_needed: The original video and timecodes, plus native pre-clear and solved tooltips for comparison.
how: Capture R6 and comparable solved and locked entries on a stock client. Record version, packs, mods and advanced-tooltip setting. Compare native text, solved hints and video overlays separately.
would_change: A reproducible pre-clear difference over ordinary Journal formatting could select an input for a fixed rule.

title: What survives a first R5 clear on Main?
why: A returned object and a retained Journal instruction would support different follow-up questions.
known: The Alpha clip shows the visible drops disappear and the solved condition remain readable. It lacks a full pickup or inventory check.
answer_needed: An uncut first clear on Main with the lake surface, inventory, messages and newly opened R6 tooltip.
how: Look for an existing original recording. Compare before the Feather arrives through disappearance, any pickup, and the R6 Journal opening.
would_change: A documented return would select a physical object to investigate. Its absence in a complete capture would narrow that procedure.

title: What originally pointed hunters to the R2–R5 actions?
why: A known successful action and the evidence that first suggested it answer different questions.
known: R1 offers a genuine extraction control. For R5, the available explanation by Jonas / JustCody followed the successful attempt.
answer_needed: Dated pre-success messages or recordings identifying the clue or observation that selected the item and conditions.
how: Trace each stage separately. Label successful procedure, contemporary reasoning and retrospective explanation in chronological order.
would_change: A documented recognition path would tell us which cues are reasonable to investigate for R6.
